item.title: Diverse Literatures and Canon Formation in Indian Higher Education
item.description: In India, the idea of a national literary canon is uniquely complex due to the country’s immense linguistic, cultural, and religious diversity. This very diversity, often seen as a challenge, might in fact be the solution to the narrowing scope of global literary canons.
